{{Quote|I'm to break up a local small-time group of smugglers who call themselves Beachcombers. If possible, I'm supposed to arrest their leader, Phranis Bolgar|[[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]]|<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" />}}
'''Phranis Bolgar''' was a [[Beachcombers|Beachcomber]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] leader who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He might be related to another Beachcomber leader, [[Lonnley Bolgar]]. Phranis Bolgar was arrested by [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] agent [[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]].<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phranis Bolgar was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Phranis Bolgar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
